name: IconPark TwoTone
about: IconPark TwoTone is a free, open-source icon set with 1,947 icons designed by ByteDance. From navigation and actions to files, media and communication, it covers everyday UI needs. Every icon is available as SVG, PNG and WebP, or as a copy-paste React / TypeScript component or CDN link. Recolor and resize each one in the browser before you export – free, no account needed. Licensed under Apache 2.0.

faqs.q: Are IconPark TwoTone free to use?
faqs.a: Yes. All 1,947 IconPark TwoTone are open source under the Apache 2.0 license – free to download, customize and use. Always check the Apache 2.0 terms for attribution or commercial-use requirements.

faqs.q: How do I use IconPark TwoTone in React or my website?
faqs.a: Copy any icon as a React / TypeScript component straight into your project, or paste the CDN link into your HTML. Every icon also downloads as SVG, PNG or WebP, and you can recolor and resize it in the browser before you export.

faqs.q: How many IconPark TwoTone are there?
faqs.a: There are 1,947 icons in the IconPark TwoTone set, designed by ByteDance. Use the search above to find any icon by name.

faqs.q: Can I change the color and size of IconPark TwoTone?
faqs.a: Yes. Open any icon, pick a size and color, and the preview updates instantly. SVG, PNG and WebP exports follow your choices, and React snippets recolor through props.

faqs.q: What formats are IconPark TwoTone available in?
faqs.a: SVG, PNG and WebP downloads, copy-paste React / TypeScript components, plus a CDN link for every single icon – free, no account needed.
